title: Country Climate and Development Report: Western Balkans 6, Kosovo Country Compendium
temporal_coverage: Country compendium dated October 2024; includes hazard history and climate projections.
methodology: Country assessment combining climate and hazard exposure, socioeconomic vulnerability, adaptation analysis, and economic modeling.
limitations: The report summarizes model outputs and cited hazard inventories; figures are not a new event-attribution study.

title: Climate Change Strategy 2019-2028 and Action Plan on Climate Change 2019-2021
organization: Ministry of Environment and Spatial Planning, Government of Kosovo
temporal_coverage: Government strategy document dated 2018; action-plan period 2019-2021.
methodology: Strategy developed by an inter-ministerial working group with expert support and stakeholder consultation, including a local questionnaire exercise.
limitations: The inspected PDF is the 2018 strategy version and contains dated baseline data; it is not evidence of current implementation status.

title: Kosovo's First and Voluntary Nationally Determined Contribution
organization: Ministry of Environment, Spatial Planning and Infrastructure, Government of Kosovo
temporal_coverage: Voluntary NDC adopted in 2025; mitigation targets extend to 2030 and adaptation sections describe current and prospective risks.
methodology: Government submission synthesizing climate-risk evidence and proposed measures.
limitations: Many measures are voluntary, conditional, and unfunded.

title: A Climate Landscape Analysis for Children: Policy Brief
temporal_coverage: Child climate and environmental vulnerability synthesis, including observed events and health reports through 2023.
methodology: Four-page UNICEF policy brief summarizing its 2024 Climate Landscape Analysis for Children.
limitations: Brief-level summary; it gives no district rates or causal estimates.

title: Mine Action and the Resilience of Communities to Climate Change
organization: Geneva International Centre for Humanitarian Demining (GICHD)
temporal_coverage: Mine-action policy and community case studies, including clearance activity through 2023 and status statements made in the report.
methodology: Document review and interviews; Kosovo material covers mine-action institutions and two local cases.
limitations: Qualitative cases are not causal impact evaluations; status reflects the report period.

title: Intervention Plan for Rural Development to Mitigate and Adapt to Climate Change, 2023–2028
organization: Municipality of Prizren, with support from UNDP Kosovo
temporal_coverage: Municipal rural-development plan for 2023–2028, dated November 2022.
methodology: Municipal sectoral intervention plan with proposed actions, timelines, responsible offices and estimated costs.
limitations: The plan records proposals and scheduled actions, not verified implementation; 2023–2025 milestones are now elapsed.

title: Community Flood Vulnerability and Adaptive Capacity in the Municipality of Podujeva: Results of the CLIPP Household Survey
organization: University of Prishtina and Municipality of Podujeva
temporal_coverage: Household survey conducted 1 June–31 July 2026; record version published 5 August 2026.
methodology: Municipal household survey with 101 responses; the publisher record summarizes aggregated findings and methods.
limitations: Publisher record only was accessible; findings describe participating households, not a representative municipal sample; item denominators vary.
